integrity: The source theorem on irrotationality is attributed rather than claimed as new. Verification scripts test finite instances; the written proof covers infinite L. No independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Fixed connected finite graph with cycles; positive fixed integer edge lengths; independent uniform 3-color data; eventual synchronization only; o(1) error not explicit; historical literature incompletely accessible.
title: Cycle-rank suppression and a weighted co-tree amplitude for synchronization under graph subdivisions
